dedupe_keys.name: southeast asia oil palm extent and detection year map

description: The International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis distributes a map of oil-palm extent and first detection across Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand. Nine 16-bit GeoTIFF tiles at 30-metre resolution encode the year when plantations first became detectable, using values 4–37 for 1984–2017 and zero for no data. The archive is available as a public ZIP and is free under CC BY 4.0. It can support spatial agricultural-supply scenarios and land-use constraints in ecosystem-service simulations such as model-invest. A caveat is that first detection occurs when palms are already approximately two to three years old, so it is not the planting date. Cloud, classification and small-plantation effects should be considered before estimating productive area. The map is a historical reconstruction, not a live plantation register. Only the landing-page description and access metadata were checked.
